narrative.overview: A contemporary field record for census geography: warm paper, precise survey ink, sparse coordinate lines and a single terracotta signal. Academic and operational rather than commercial.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper with deep blue-green ink.
Editorial serif questions with familiar sans controls.
Coordinate grids only where measurement is meaningful.
Terracotta marks actions, warnings and observed points.

rules.name: The Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Terracotta identifies primary action, warning or selected evidence; it is not general decoration.

rules.name: The Evidence Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels are reserved for datelines, metric names and short research metadata.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Tables, ledgers and warning bands use tonal contrast and rules; they do not float.

dos: Do keep dataset year and census block group scope close to predictions.
Do use charts and generated artifacts as the strongest visual evidence.
Do preserve keyboard focus, error, disabled, loading and empty states.
donts: Don't borrow real-estate marketplace photography, pricing badges or sales language.
Don't use terracotta as background decoration unrelated to state or meaning.
Don't put the coordinate grid behind ordinary long-form content.
Don't turn every section into a rounded card.
